steps.prompt: Create an image. Pixel art sprite sheet for a handheld game. The attached image is the existing sprite sheet of this exact character (Tho Nguu, an earth element ox, LEGENDARY (final mythic form) stage). Draw NEW animation frames of the SAME character: identical pixel art style, palette, dark outline, proportions, body shape, colours, markings and accessories, and the same size as in the attached sheet, always facing right. Square canvas 1024x1024, flat solid magenta background #FF00FF everywhere (no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no text, no numbers, no grid lines). NO food, NO props, NO human hands. Grid of 4 columns x 4 rows, one character per cell, centered, the whole character fully inside its cell (nothing cropped), sprites must not touch each other, feet on the same line in every cell except the mid-air frames. Row 1: (1) standing idle exactly like the first frame of the attached sheet; (2) EAT: grazing with its head down; (3) EAT: tearing off a mouthful; (4) EAT: chewing slowly side to side. Row 2: (5) EAT: licking its nose with a long tongue, happy moo; (6) PLAY: pawing the ground; (7) PLAY: charging forward with head down; (8) PLAY: head-butting the air. Row 3: (9) PLAY: bucking with a back kick; (10) PLAY: skidding to a stop in a dust cloud; (11) PLAY: proud pose, chest out; (12) REFUSE food: snorting and turning its head. Row 4: (13) PETTED: eyes closed, leaning in, tail swishing; (14) WAVE hello: lifting a hoof; (15) SAD: lying down, ears flat; (16) ANGRY: steam snorting from its nostrils, horns lowered.
